summary: End-to-end frontend testing of the new My Ideas TWO-PASS workflow with global knowledge map + integrated inquiry plan. 15 of 16 review scenarios pass. Backend (curl-verified by main agent) integrates cleanly through every phase (pass1 -> knowledge_map -> inquiry_plan -> inquiry_paused -> pass2 -> construct -> done). One real UX blocker found: on the LAST question of PASS 2, the 'Build my ideas' button is stuck disabled after typing an answer because it gates on the persisted allPass2Answered (ideas.responses[i].pass2_text) rather than the local unsaved answer. There is no Next button on the last question, so the user must manually click 'Share with my coach' to persist before the Build button un-disables. All other flows (redirect, non-blocking pass1, structural coaching with no subject-matter leakage, present/gap map, self-assessment challenge, inquiry plan with needs+source chips, pause+resume, refresh persistence across paused and knowledge_map phases, pass2 mi-original-answer + revise, construct guidance, construct save -> done, ot-continue-button becoming enabled and advancing to My Current Answer, side-panel collapse with active-only expansion, panel toggle without changing active stage, draft preservation across a panel toggle, and narrow ~500px viewport) all verified working.

ui_bugs.issue: mi-build-button stays disabled when the student types the last-question answer. Its disabled predicate is `busy || !allPass2Answered`, where allPass2Answered is computed from ideas.responses[i].pass2_text (persisted). Because there is no Next button on the last question and Build itself calls persistIfDirty inside its handler, the button can never become enabled purely by typing — the user must click 'Share with my coach' first to persist the last answer. From a user's perspective the Build button appears broken.

action_items: Fix mi-build-button enabled predicate on the last Pass-2 question: either (a) also enable when the local `answer` state is non-empty (mirror the mi-next-button predicate `!answer.trim()`) since toConstruct already runs persistIfDirty; or (b) auto-persist pass2_text on textarea blur / debounced onChange; or (c) always compute allPass2Answered against `i===idx ? (answer||resp.pass2_text) : resp.pass2_text`. Same class of issue may exist on mi-to-map-button (last question of Pass 1) — it currently requires `!answer.trim()` in its own disabled check so it works for freshly typed answers, but its persistIfDirty runs inside toMap after the disabled check is already false; recommend applying the same pattern to Build.
critical_code_review_comments: MyIdeasWorkflow.jsx: `allPass2Answered = questions.every((_, i) => (ideas.responses[String(i)]?.pass2_text || '').trim())` is read from persisted state only. Combined with the last-question having only Share + Build (no Next), the student can enter a valid answer and see Build permanently disabled. This is the single most blocking issue for the whole two-pass flow.
MyIdeasWorkflow.jsx line 296: mi-next-button `disabled={busy || !answer.trim()}` correctly consults local state; the Build button should follow the same convention for the current index.

success_rate.frontend: 94% (15/16 flows fully green; 1 button-enablement bug on Pass 2 last question)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed working via UI: (1) ?preview=ot -> Begin -> assignment -> OT rail with 5 stages. (2) Clicking ot-stage-my_ideas with no questions saved redirects to Questions I Need to Answer. (3) After saving 2-3 questions and jumping to My Ideas, ONE question shows at a time with mi-question-index; mi-next-button advances non-blocking on weak/interpretable answers (Pass 1). (4) mi-share-button returns structural coach feedback (mi-coach-message) that describes DEFINITION/COMPARISON/EXPLANATION structure and points back to the student's own answer without supplying the correct fact — verified on a definition-with-behavior answer for 'What is photosynthesis?' and an explanation-with-only-outcome answer. (5) mi-to-map-button transitions to mi-knowledge-map with mi-map-row-i containing mi-map-present-i and mi-map-gap-i and three status buttons per row. (6) Marking a weak answer as can_answer + confirming yields mi-challenge-0 that invites reconsideration without forcing. (7) mi-make-plan-button produces mi-inquiry-plan with mi-plan-need-* and mi-plan-source-* chips. (8) mi-pause-button -> mi-paused; refresh persists mi-paused; mi-resume-button -> Pass 2 with mi-original-answer visible above mi-answer-input. (9) After revising, on the LAST question of Pass 2 the Build button is broken (see ui_bugs). Workaround: click mi-share-button first, then mi-build-button becomes enabled and transitions to mi-construct with mi-construct-guidance from Claude Haiku. mi-construct-save (>=10 chars) -> mi-done, and ot-continue-button un-disables and advances to My Current Answer. (10) OTThinkingPanel: non-active objects are collapsed by default; ot-panel-toggle-<key> expands/collapses in place without changing the active stage; ot-panel-original stays visible with original assignment; typing unsaved draft in ot-object-input survives clicking a panel toggle. (11) Narrow ~500px viewport: rail wraps, workflow and ot-thinking-panel both render below each other, mi-answer-input is fully editable. Screenshots in /app/test_reports/: mi_map.png, mi_done.png, narrow.png, final_state.png.
rca of the issue: mi-build-button is rendered on the last Pass-2 question with `disabled={busy || !allPass2Answered}` where `allPass2Answered = questions.every((_, i) => (ideas.responses[String(i)]?.pass2_text || '').trim())`. The map ideas.responses is only mutated server-side via otIdeasInteract (called by Share) or otIdeasAdvance (called by Next). On the LAST question there is no Next button, so a freshly typed answer for the final question never lands in ideas.responses[last].pass2_text, and the predicate keeps Build disabled forever. Confirmed reproducibly: after filling mi-answer-input on Q3 of Pass 2 without clicking Share, a 30s click retry on mi-build-button fails ('element is not enabled'). Clicking mi-share-button first persists pass2_text and Build becomes enabled and completes the flow (verified end-to-end through mi-construct -> mi-done -> ot-continue-button -> My Current Answer).
